title: Patch: Inner Fire sets Attack equal to Health on a Unit whose Attack stands below 0, where it now comes up short

**Issue #4840 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #4840: Patch: Inner Fire sets Attack equal to Health on a Unit whose Attack stands below 0, where it now comes up short
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

### What happens

S #10.1 Inner Fire ("Set a Unit's Attack equal to its Health") works out the buff it needs from the Unit's **shown** Attack, which is floored at 0:

```rust
// crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c010_1_inner_fire.rs:39
let attack = (view.health + shift).max(0) - view.attack;
```

A Unit whose Attack stands below 0 underneath the floor then comes up short by that much.

Concrete: a 1/5 stands under Core #65.1 Spikey Pillow ("Your Units have −2 Attack"), so it shows 0 Attack with −1 underneath. Base Inner Fire buffs by 5 − 0 = +5 and the Unit shows **4/5**. Radiant Inner Fire on its caster's own Unit shows 8, not 9. Any Unit carried below 0 reaches this: the Pillow here, a Nerf, or Core #46 Suppressive Aura (the last two by reading).

### What should happen

- R1867002: "Attack becomes Health plus the running face's shift, with a floor of 0", read "through the §10.4 layers", auras included.
- R1868001, which names "S #10.1 Inner Fire's reading", sets a number exactly by reading the Attack "before layer 5's floor (`unclamped_attack`…), so every Unit shows exactly 0, one Nerfed below 0 included". S #118 Secure System does this (`c118_secure_system.rs`); Inner Fire does not.

### How to reproduce

Two tests fail on `main` (3a83bd7), in [`crates/ai/tests/audit_cards_stinky.rs` at ca59d7a](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/ca59d7a/crates/ai/tests/audit_cards_stinky.rs) (branch `claude/vigilant-mayer-pmyrhr`).

```rust
use jackioh_engine::testkit::*;
const P1: PlayerId = PlayerId::P1;
const FILLER: &str = "core-005";

fn inner_fire_under_a_pillow(radiant: bool) -> (i32, i32) {
    jackioh_cards::register_all();
    const INNER_FIRE: &str = "stinkyscape-010-1";
    const PILLOW: &str = "core-065-1";
    let mut s = scenario(json!({
        "p1": {
            "hand": [{ "def": INNER_FIRE, "radiant": radiant }, FILLER],
            "field": [{ "def": "stand-in (1) 1/5", "lane": 1 }, { "def": PILLOW, "lane": 3 }],
            "library": vec[FILLER; 4], "mana": 10,
        },
        "p2": { "hand": [FILLER], "library": vec[FILLER; 4] },
    }));
    let unit = s.unit_at(P1, 1);
    assert_eq!(s.stats(&unit).attack, 0, "1 Attack under −2 shows 0");
    s.play(INNER_FIRE, pick::targets(pick::instance(&unit)));
    let after = s.stats(&unit);
    (after.attack, after.health)
}
#[test]
fn inner_fire_sets_attack_to_health_on_a_unit_below_zero_attack() {
    let (attack, health) = inner_fire_under_a_pillow(false);
    assert_eq!(attack, health, "R1867002: Attack becomes Health");
}
#[test]
fn radiant_inner_fire_sets_attack_to_health_plus_four_on_a_unit_below_zero_attack() {
    let (attack, health) = inner_fire_under_a_pillow(true);
    assert_eq!(attack, health + 4, "R1867002: Attack becomes Health plus the shift");
}
```

Output today: `R1867002: Attack becomes Health   left: 4   right: 5` and `…plus the shift   left: 8   right: 9`.

### Where

A card: `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c010_1_inner_fire.rs`.

### Version or commit

`main` at 3a83bd7.

### Notes for the fix

- Subtract `unclamped_attack(&*ctx.state, &unit)` instead of `view.attack`, as Secure System does. A script reads state through the prelude's read helpers (CLAUDE.md, Architecture); `unclamped_attack` is one.
- The card's tests go in its own file (CLAUDE.md rule 6): a Unit below 0, on both faces. Its tests today never put a Unit below 0.
- Unsecure System's doubling of a Unit that shows 0 is ruled to stay at 0 (R1868001), so it is not affected.
- The same floored-against-raw mismatch was found in the AI's redaction (#4803); a grep for other scripts that subtract `view.attack` or `stats(..).attack` to set a number would show whether there is a third.
- A card change in play: read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` first; it needs its pending patch fragment.

Found by an audit of the Stinkyscape card scripts against their printed text; the reproductions were run and the script read before filing.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45562937877)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Fix Stinkyscape #10.1 Inner Fire so a Unit whose Attack stands below 0 (under an aura such as Spikey Pillow's −2, a Nerf, or Suppressive Aura) ends at exactly its Health (base face) or Health plus/minus the Radiant shift, per the already-ruling notes R1867002 and R1868001. The fix is a one-line read change in the card script plus its kept-script replay entry, its in-file tests, and its pending patch fragment. No new ruling and no spec change: the behavior is already decided.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c010_1_inner_fire.rs` | change | Line 39: subtract `unclamped_attack` instead of `view.attack`; header comment names the helper; new `script_v0_6_13h` kept-script fn; new tests in existing `mod tests` |
| `crates/cards/src/history.rs` | change | Add `c010_1_inner_fire` to the `use crate::scripts::stinkyscape::{…}` block (line 71, before `c010_2_divine_spirit`); append one `KEPT_SCRIPTS` row |
| `crates/cards/catalog.json` | change only if `loc` moved | `stinkyscape-010-1` entry's `loc` (now 34), only if `cargo jackioh catalog loc` prints a new number after the kept fn is added |
| `crates/cards/patches/pending/<slug>.json` | new | Pending patch fragment, created by the `cargo jackioh patches` command in step 5, player note edited by hand |

Do not touch: anything under `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`; `spec/rulings/`, `spec/pending/`, `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/CARDS.md`, `spec/history/` (no new ruling: R1867002 and R1868001 already rule this). Governing spec: §8.10 row S 10.1, §10.4, R386, R1867002, R1868001.

## Steps

1. **Re-read the two ruling notes** (`spec/rulings/R1867002.md`, `spec/rulings/R1868001.md`) and the model file `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c118_secure_system.rs` (lines 1–35: header phrasing and line 22's `unclamped_attack(&*ctx.state, unit)` read). `unclamped_attack` reaches card scripts through the existing `use jackioh_engine::prelude::*;` glob (the prelude does `pub use crate::layers::*;`), so no import is added.
2. **Fix the buff math** in `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c010_1_inner_fire.rs`, in the `cry` hook of `inner_fire`. Replace line 39:
   ```rust
   let attack = (view.health + shift).max(0) - view.attack;
   ```
   with:
   ```rust
   let attack = (view.health + shift).max(0) - unclamped_attack(&*ctx.state, &unit);
   ```
   Keep `view.health` as the Health read and keep the `.max(0)` floor. Touch nothing else in the hook.
3. **Update the file's header comment** (lines 7–10) to name the read, copying Secure System's phrasing: the Attack is read "before layer 5's floor (`unclamped_attack`, the reading KY's Constant sets a number with)". One sentence; do not rewrite the header.
4. **Keep the replaced script for replays** (docs/ADDING_CARDS.md §3; replay folding, R767000). In the same card file, above `#[cfg(test)]`, add:
   ```rust
   /// R767000: through v0.6.13h the buff was taken off the shown (floored) Attack (issue #4840);
   /// `KEPT_SCRIPTS` folds those replays under it.
   pub fn script_v0_6_13h() -> CardScripts {
       CardScripts {
           base: inner_fire(false),
           radiant: inner_fire(true),
       }
   }
   ```
   but with the OLD one-line body: implement it by duplicating `inner_fire` as it was (subtracting `view.attack`) under a private `inner_fire_v0_6_13h` helper, or by inlining the old hook — copy the exact pattern from `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c119_unsecure_system.rs` lines 50–63 (`script_v0_6_6d` delegating to the old `unsecure_system` variant). Then in `crates/cards/src/history.rs`: add `c010_1_inner_fire` to the stinkyscape `use` block at line 71 (alphabetical, before `c010_2_divine_spirit`), and append to `KEPT_SCRIPTS`, next to the other Stinkyscape rows:
   ```rust
   // #4840 (R1867002): the buffs before the unfloored-Attack reading.
   (
       c010_1_inner_fire::ID,
       "v0.6.13h",
       c010_1_inner_fire::script_v0_6_13h,
   ),
   ```
   `v0.6.13h` is the newest shipped version (tail of `crates/cards/patches/shipped.json`).
5. **Claim the card change with a pending fragment** (docs/ADDING_CARDS.md §3). Run:
   ```
   cargo jackioh patches "Inner Fire reads Attack below 0" --source "#4840" --notes "Inner Fire took its buff off the shown Attack, so a Unit below 0 came up short; it now reads Attack before layer 5's floor" --plays stinkyscape-010-1
   ```
   This creates `crates/cards/patches/pending/<slug>.json`. Then hand-edit that file's `player` note (R724001: a short title plus one fact per line under `fixes`; running the command again keeps it). If step 7 shows a `loc` move, the fragment must also claim the catalog entry — follow `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` output, not this sentence, for `--plays` vs `--cards`.
6. **Grep for a third instance of the same bug** (the issue's note, bounded): run `grep -rn -- "- view.attack\|- stats\|attack: -" crates/cards/src/scripts/` and confirm each hit either is the fixed line or reads shown Attack for a threshold, cost, or multiplier (those correctly use the floored value; e.g. `c119_unsecure_system.rs:23` doubles shown Attack per R1868001, `c137_3_air_doctrine.rs:26` multiplies it). Change no other card; report the grep output's verdict in one line.
7. **Reconcile `loc`**. Run `cargo jackioh catalog loc crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c010_1_inner_fire.rs`. If the number differs from the catalog entry's `loc` (34), write the new number into `crates/cards/catalog.json`'s `stinkyscape-010-1` entry and re-check step 5's claim. (`count_loc` counts code lines above the first `#[cfg(test)]`, so the kept fn moves it; `catalog check` passes when `loc` equals the shipped snapshot or the counted value.)

## Tests

All tests live in the card's own file per CLAUDE.md rule 6 (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c010_1_inner_fire.rs`, `mod tests`); add no test files elsewhere.

- `mod base`: new `r1867002_a_unit_below_0_attack_becomes_exactly_its_health` — copy the issue's reproduction verbatim: field a `stand-in (1) 1/5` in lane 1 and `core-065-1` (Spikey Pillow, −2 aura) in lane 3, assert shown attack is 0 before the play, play base Inner Fire on the unit, assert `attack == health` (5/5). Fails before the fix at 4/5.
- `mod radiant`: new `r1867002_a_friendly_unit_below_0_attack_gains_health_plus_shift` — same board with the Radiant face (`{ "def": INNER_FIRE, "radiant": true }`), assert the unit shows 9 (5 + shift 4). Fails before the fix at 8.
- `mod v0_6_13h` (new module, copy `c119_unsecure_system.rs` lines 176–191): new `r767000_a_game_on_v0_6_13h_lands_short_under_an_aura` — inside `crate::under_kept(ID, script_v0_6_13h(), || { … })`, replay the base-face Pillow board and assert the unit shows 4/5 (the old wrong value), proving the kept script preserves old replays.
- Do not add tests for Unsecure System (ruled to stay at 0 by R1868001) or for other cards from step 6's grep.
- Commands, in order: `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c010_1_inner_fire` (all tests in the file must pass, kept-script test included); `cargo jackioh catalog check`; `cargo jackioh patches check`; `cargo jackioh spec check`; `cargo fmt --check`; `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`. Then `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` and obey it for the fragment's claim.

## Done when

- [ ] Base Inner Fire on a unit below 0 shows exactly Health; Radiant on its caster's own unit shows Health + 4 (both new tests green).
- [ ] Old behavior is preserved under the kept script (`v0_6_13h` test green) and `KEPT_SCRIPTS` names `(c010_1_inner_fire::ID, "v0.6.13h", …)`.
- [ ] Step 6's grep is done and no third card is changed.
- [ ] `catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check`, `fmt --check`, and `clippy -p jackioh-cards` are all green; `classify --claims` agrees with the fragment.
- [ ] The pending fragment exists with a hand-written player note under `fixes`.
- [ ] No file outside the **Files to touch** table is modified (`git status --porcelain` shows only those rows).

## Risks

- **Replay determinism (R767000):** the fix changes folded games that cast Inner Fire on a below-0 unit; the kept-script entry plus its `under_kept` test is what keeps old finals hashing. Do not skip step 4.
- **`loc` drift:** the kept fn silently moves the counted `loc`; step 7 plus `catalog check` catches it. Do not hand-edit `loc` to any number but the tool's output.
- **Over-claiming the fragment:** a `--cards` claim where `--plays` suffices (or vice versa) fails CI's `rust (classify)`; treat `classify --claims` as authoritative over step 5's draft flags.
- **Purity (CLAUDE.md rule 4):** the script only swaps one read helper for another; no new imports, no state access outside the prelude helpers, no `#[allow]` additions (never add any per the Never list).

## Open questions

None. The task is fully decided by R1867002/R1868001 plus the issue's reproduction; the two noted alternatives — adding a new ruling (rejected: the point is already ruled, and a decided point is not ruled again) and touching Unsecure System (rejected: R1868001 rules its doubling to stay at 0) — are explicitly out of scope.
````
